description: This file defines a functional interface 'PubSubTopicExtractor' used for extracting topics from messages within a pub/sub system. It includes methods for extracting topics and composing multiple extractors.

classes.name: PubSubTopicExtractor
classes.description: A functional interface for extracting pub/sub topics from messages of generic type T, providing methods to retrieve topics and combine extractors.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns a collection of topics extracted from a message of type T.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a combined extractor that merges topics from this extractor and another, or a collection of extractors.
